title: Does everything I need!
body: So I started homelabbing and I have a few Ubuntu hosts that I like to connect to. Two are my own system and one is a VPS. I’m able to connect to all three flawlessly and even setting up a jump server to connect to my VPS on a single whitelisted host was easy to setup. I’d highly recommend this app over alternatives. It’s great!

title: Solid app with a solid developer
body: The app functions well, and is well designed. I can connect to my remote machines, even through a jump host. It has useful keyboard shortcut buttons for pasting command snippets. It even supports port forwarding and file browsing/transfer. The pro version is worth the money since it’s a one-time payment, and supports the developer, who is super responsive on Reddit and implements requested features.

title: Perhaps the Best Apple SSH Client
body: This is a new SSH client available on macOS and iOS that nobody seems to know about. It has a nice GUI and syncs between Apple devices seamlessly and is a must-have for anyone who does a lot of SSH work via Apple devices. For an individual, I think this is overall better than something like Termius because a lifetime license for Termix is only $10 and has most of what you’d need as an individual. Keep up the good work!

title: Best, most accurate terminal emulator on iPad
body: I’ve used (and paid for) my fair share of terminal emulators on the iPad, and this one is by far the best. It has absolutely perfect rendering. I’m able to open neovim from my remote server and everything renders pixel accurately. And it’s FAST. Also, being able to speed up the key repeat is just absolutely clutch and makes navigating my nvim environment so much faster. My only real complaints are I wish there was support for using mosh in addition to ssh, I wish there was a way to go full screen when using an external keyboard, and I wish copy/paste worked from the keyboard (this is a weird omission). But honestly I can live with these small shortcomings since this app gets the basics absolutely perfect.
